svg.title: diopside 現行AWS物理構成図
svg.desc: 現行CDKとruntimeに存在するCloudFront、S3、EventBridge、Lambda、SQS、DynamoDB、Secrets Manager、CloudWatch、X-Ray、SNS、Budgets、IAMおよびSTSをAWS公式アイコンで示す。実装済みの接続は実線、未実装または未検証の経路は赤い破線で示す。
svg.text: 2026-08-01 · repository / CDK / runtime deployment view · not an AWS deployment or production-acceptance claim

g.text: Collector: create Job records in ControlTable; enqueue JobQueue
Processor: read Secrets + Configuration; write Processed; R/W ControlTable
Open gap: Processor needs Raw PutObject (GAP-IAM-PROCESSOR-001)
Exporter: read Processed/Configuration; delete Raw/Processed; R/W ControlTable
Exporter: write PublicData (delivery zone); invalidate Amazon CloudFront

svg.text: email notification when AlertEmail is set
Legend: solid arrow = current CDK/runtime relationship · double-headed arrow = the same Exporter enqueues and is invoked by SQS · red dashed = open gap or redrive
Data boundary: payloads and public artifacts = Amazon S3 · small control state = Amazon DynamoDB (DEC-DB-001)
